title: PR #19 — Security headers, a11y, performance budgets, and PWA
description: Harden the deployed surface and finish quality budgets: nonce-based CSP and headers, WCAG 2.1 AA on core flows, bundle and LCP budgets with no ciphertext in SSR HTML, and an installable offline shell. Requirement IDs: TASK-48, TASK-49, TASK-50, TASK-51.
acceptanceCriteria: Responses set HSTS, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and a restrictive Permissions-Policy
CSP uses a per-request nonce and blocks inline scripts without the nonce; any exception is minimal and documented
Mutating requests reject cross-origin Origin/Host mismatches and no GET mutates state
axe-core reports zero critical or serious violations on setup, login, 2FA, unlock, list, editor, and generator
A keyboard-only run completes setup → create item → lock → unlock, and dialog focus is restored on close
Initial JS for unauthenticated routes is under 200KB gzip and the vault route chunk is under 150KB gzip
Unlock derivation stays under the p95 budget and LCP is under 2.5s on throttled 4G
No ciphertext appears in server-rendered HTML for vault routes
The app is installable and boots its shell offline, with vault data served only from IndexedDB
A new deploy triggers an update prompt

steps.details: Generate a per-request nonce in `entry.server.tsx`, attach it to React Router's inline hydration scripts, and emit a `Content-Security-Policy` header from the Worker or entry server. Start from `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-<n>'; style-src 'self' 'nonce-<n>'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'`. If an inline script cannot be covered, document the narrowest exception in the PR body and in `docs/threat-model.md`.

steps.description: Add remaining security headers and CSRF checks
steps.details: Set HSTS (1 year, includeSubDomains), nosniff, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, and `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()`. Add a helper that rejects mutating requests whose `Origin` does not match `APP_ORIGIN`. Verify every mutation uses POST/PATCH/DELETE and no loader mutates.

Add axe-core to Playwright and run it on the seven listed surfaces. Fix landmarks, heading order, labels, `aria-describedby` error associations, focus trap/restore in dialogs, live regions for toasts, and contrast. Document any intentional exclusion in the PR body.

Move crypto imports behind dynamic `import()` on unlock/setup routes, lazy-load editor routes, and remove unused shadcn primitives. Add a build-size check script that fails when budgets are exceeded. Add a Lighthouse CI or Playwright trace assertion for LCP on throttled 4G.

steps.description: Prove no ciphertext in SSR HTML
steps.details: Make vault routes render only after unlock via client loaders, and add an integration test that fetches `/app` HTML with a seeded vault and asserts the response body contains no `data_ct` or item identifier beyond what is required. Assert the response has `Cache-Control: no-store` for authenticated HTML.

Add a web manifest (name, short_name, icons, theme_color, display standalone, start_url `/app`). Add a service worker that precaches the app shell and static assets with a versioned cache, uses network-first for navigations with an offline fallback, and never caches `/api/*`. Add an update prompt when a new worker activates.

Playwright: assert headers on the document and on API responses; assert a cross-origin POST is rejected; run axe; assert budget gate; block network and reload to confirm the shell boots and shows the locked overlay. Capture before/after Lighthouse numbers for the PR body.

technicalNotes: CSP nonce support for React Router's inline hydration scripts is the highest-risk item in this PR; validate early and split the PR if it cannot be done cleanly.
Do not use `unsafe-inline` for scripts in production.
Never cache API responses in the service worker, even encrypted ones.
Keep the offline shell free of vault data; the lock overlay must appear before any decryption.
If Lighthouse CI is unavailable, use Playwright with CDP throttling and record the trace.
